name: Total Revenue
dax:
VAR CurrentDept = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Department'[Department_Group])

// ?????????? ISINSCOPE ???? ISFILTERED ????????????????????? Cross-filter ?????????? Detail
VAR IsDeptFiltered = ISFILTERED('Dim_Department'[Department_Group])

// 1. ?????????????????????? (??????????????)
VAR NormalRev = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Income_Plan'[Plan Amount]),
        FILTER(
            VALUES('Dim_Department'[Department_Group]),
            NOT(ISBLANK('Dim_Department'[Department_Group]))
        )
    )

// 2. ??????????????? "???" (??? REMOVEFILTERS ???????????????????)
VAR Move_AS400 = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Income_Plan'[Plan Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        'Dim_solution'[Solution Name] = "SWD",
        FILTER(ALL('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name]), CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "AS400"))
    )

VAR Move_ISZ = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Income_Plan'[Plan Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        'Dim_solution'[Solution Name] = "SWD",
        FILTER(ALL('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name]), CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "ClientB"))
    )

VAR Move_Nova = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Income_Plan'[Plan Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        'Dim_solution'[Solution Name] = "MPOS",
        FILTER(ALL('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name]), CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "Nova"))
    )

// 3. ??????????????
VAR Result = 
    IF(
        IsDeptFiltered,
        SWITCH(TRUE(),
            // ??????????? SBS -> ?????? AS400 ??? ClientB ??????????????
            CurrentDept = "SBS", NormalRev + Move_AS400 + Move_ISZ - Move_Nova,
            
            // ??????????? SWD -> ?????????? AS400 ??? ClientB ??? (?????????? SBS ????)
            CurrentDept = "SWD", NormalRev - Move_AS400 - Move_ISZ,
            
            // ??????????? ENT -> ?????? Nova ??????????????
            CurrentDept = "ENT", NormalRev + Move_Nova,
            
            // ????????? -> ?????????????? ????????????????????
            NormalRev
        ),
        NormalRev // ????????? Filter ??????????? (????????) ??????????????????
    )

RETURN Result

name: Total Project Cost
dax:
VAR CurrentDept = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Department'[Department_Group])
VAR IsDeptFiltered = ISFILTERED('Dim_Department'[Department_Group])

// 1. ?????????? (? ?????????????????????????????????? ???? Blank, "", "(Blank)")
VAR NormalCost = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Actual Amount]),
        FILTER(
            VALUES('Dim_Department'[Department_Group]),
            NOT(ISBLANK('Dim_Department'[Department_Group]))
        ),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            FILTER(
                ALL('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code]),
                NOT(ISBLANK('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code])) && 
                TRIM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code]) <> "" && 
                'Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code] <> "(Blank)"
            )
        ),
        CROSSFILTER('Fact_Opportunity'[Project Code], 'Dim_Project'[Project Code], BOTH)
    )

// 2. ??????????????? "???"
// 2.1 ? ?????? Project Code ??????????? ?????????????????? CSI (?????????????!)
VAR Move_Blank_CSI = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Actual Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            FILTER(
                ALL('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code]),
                ISBLANK('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code]) || 
                TRIM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code]) = "" || 
                'Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code] = "(Blank)"
            )
        )
    )

// 2.2 ??? TPK-HRM ???? SWD
VAR Move_TPK_SWD = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Actual Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        'Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code] = "TPK-HRM",
        FILTER(ALL('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name]), 
            CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "SAP interface") || 
            CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "New Emp") || 
            CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Opportunity'[Opportunity Name], "Bank Interface")
        )
    )

// 2.3 ??? TPK-HRM ???????? ???? TM
VAR Move_TPK_TM = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Actual Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        'Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code] = "TPK-HRM"
    ) - Move_TPK_SWD

// 2.4 ??? THNS ???? SBS
VAR Move_THNS = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Actual Amount]),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Department'),
        CONTAINSSTRING('Fact_Project_Expenses'[Project Code], "THNS")
    )

// 3. ???????????????? (? ??? TRIM() ?????????????????????????)
VAR ResultCost = 
    IF(
        IsDeptFiltered,
        SWITCH(TRUE(),
            TRIM(CurrentDept) = "TM", NormalCost + Move_TPK_TM,       
            TRIM(CurrentDept) = "SWD", NormalCost + Move_TPK_SWD,     
            TRIM(CurrentDept) = "SBS", NormalCost + Move_THNS,        
            TRIM(CurrentDept) = "CSI", NormalCost + Move_Blank_CSI, // ????? CSI
            NormalCost
        ),
        NormalCost + Move_Blank_CSI
    )

RETURN
    IF(ROUND(ResultCost, 2) = 0, BLANK(), ResultCost)

name: Departments at Risk
Best Month Profit
Full Year Profit&Loss
Man Cost with Idle
dax:
VAR CurrentType = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Allocate_Report'[Allocate Type])

RETURN
SUMX(
    VALUES('Dim_Date'[Month Year]),
    VAR _MinDate = MIN('Dim_Date'[Date])
    VAR _MaxDate = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
    // ?? ????????????????????????????????? (???? ??.?. = 31 ???)
    VAR _DaysInMonth = DATEDIFF(_MinDate, _MaxDate, DAY) + 1 
    
    RETURN
    SUMX(
        VALUES('Dim_Employee'[Employee No]),
        VAR EmpCost = [Total Man Cost]       
        
        // 1. ???????????????? "??????????????????? (Pro-Rate)"
        VAR TotalPct = 
            SUMX(
                FILTER(
                    RELATEDTABLE('Dim_Allocation'),
                    ('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date] <= _MaxDate || ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date])) &&
                    ('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date] >= _MinDate || ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date]))
                ),
                VAR _Start = IF(ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date]), _MinDate, 'Dim_Allocation'[Start Date])
                VAR _Finish = IF(ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date]), _MaxDate, 'Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date])
                // ?????????????-?? "??????????????????????????"
                VAR _ActualStart = IF(_Start < _MinDate, _MinDate, _Start)
                VAR _ActualFinish = IF(_Finish > _MaxDate, _MaxDate, _Finish)
                // ?????????????????????????????????
                VAR _ActiveDays = DATEDIFF(_ActualStart, _ActualFinish, DAY) + 1
                
                // ?? ??????? Pro-Rate: (??????????? / 100) x (????????? / ????????????)
                RETURN DIVIDE('Dim_Allocation'[Assign Percent], 100) * DIVIDE(_ActiveDays, _DaysInMonth)
            )
            
        // 2. ?????????????????? Type ??? "??????????????????? (Pro-Rate)"
        VAR TypePct = 
            SUMX(
                FILTER(
                    RELATEDTABLE('Dim_Allocation'),
                    'Dim_Allocation'[Allocate Type] = CurrentType &&
                    ('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date] <= _MaxDate || ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date])) &&
                    ('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date] >= _MinDate || ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date]))
                ),
                VAR _Start = IF(ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Start Date]), _MinDate, 'Dim_Allocation'[Start Date])
                VAR _Finish = IF(ISBLANK('Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date]), _MaxDate, 'Dim_Allocation'[Finish Date])
                VAR _ActualStart = IF(_Start < _MinDate, _MinDate, _Start)
                VAR _ActualFinish = IF(_Finish > _MaxDate, _MaxDate, _Finish)
                VAR _ActiveDays = DATEDIFF(_ActualStart, _ActualFinish, DAY) + 1
                
                RETURN DIVIDE('Dim_Allocation'[Assign Percent], 100) * DIVIDE(_ActiveDays, _DaysInMonth)
            )
        
        // 3. ???????????????????
        RETURN
        IF(
            ISINSCOPE('Dim_Allocate_Report'[Allocate Type]),
            IF(
                CurrentType = "Idle",
                VAR IdlePct = 1 - TotalPct
                RETURN IF(IdlePct > 0, EmpCost * IdlePct, BLANK()), // ??? Idle ???????? ????????
                
                IF(TypePct > 0, EmpCost * TypePct, BLANK()) // ??????? Type ?????????????????????
            ),
            EmpCost // ?????? Total ???????????
        )
    )
)
